name: bwdist
expr: De = bwdist(BW); Dc = bwdist(BW,'cityblock'); Dk = bwdist(BW,'chessboard'); Dq = bwdist(BW,'quasi-euclidean');
comment: Sig D=bwdist(BW[,method]). Distance to nearest TRUE pixel. method: euclidean (default, sqrt(dx^2+dy^2)), cityblock (|dx|+|dy|), chessboard (max), quasi-euclidean (diagonal=sqrt2). Corner (1,1) to feature (2,2): euclid 1.4142, city 2, chess 1, quasi 1.4142. (1,4) to (4,4): euclid 2.2361, city 3, chess 2, quasi 2.4142. numkit previously IGNORED method (always euclidean) -- now honored via 2-pass chamfer. tol=1e-6 because MATLAB bwdist returns SINGLE (float32) so irrational distances differ ~1e-8 from numkit's double; integer metrics match exactly. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
